scope: Offline paired evidence delivery on ten saved bundles. No model, search, fetch, supplement, analysis or submission calls. No outcome labels. Not a forecast accuracy experiment or a held-out test.

policy.bank_validation: Exact raw source and parsed-view hashes plus original document-local coordinates. No guessed body offsets.
policy.identity_context: At most the first 1800 saved-body characters, ending on a full line where possible. It is original text, not inferred metadata.
policy.table_policy: Whole saved table rows with their original header; no cell reinterpretation. Rank rows by the unchanged question lexical terms, not rubric or model claims.
policy.overflow: Preserve original old-visible text; expose omitted banked ranges and reasons. Never clip a row to hide the byte cap.

metrics: fixed material check delta and lost checks
valid banked characters forwarded and omitted ranges
